results.title: Last Call - USNA '58
results.content: Dottie and I were married June 7 th 1958 at our hometown church in Baltimore County, MD, my having three days earlier become a 2nd Lt. Four years were spent at Harlingen AFB in Texas gaining Navigator wings and then staying on as a "TAC" officer in the Aviation Cadet Program, followed by four years in San Antonio structuring the Officer Training School Program. Bucktrout of Williamsburg  4124 Ironbound Road  Williamsburg, VA 23188  (757) 229-3822       Annabelle Stovall Haney Annabelle (Wife of Dan Hanley 16th Co)  (12/10/25)   (October 6, 1940 -May 21, 2025)  Annabelle Stovall Haney, born and raised in Hammond, Louisiana, a radiant light whose wit and love touched the hearts of all who knew her, passed away peacefully in her memory care unit on May 21, 2025, at the age of 85. He was married to Dorothy Ann Bailey on June 7, 1958, in Newport, R.I. Leo attended the U.S. Naval Academy, graduating in 1958, with a bachelor of science degree followed by serving proudly in the Navy for over 21 years, both on surface ships and submarines, as well as shore duty.
